write-strega-expectation.reason: AgroLink Phase C reasserts fresh device scope at enqueue, fails closed, and records user originators; Task 7 adds the six scoped command fallback registrations (+720). AgroLink review E3 (Critical): PHYSICAL commands now require an actor when scoped -- an actor-less cloud command used to skip the scope check entirely and actuate anyway -- and the existing fresh-scope check now also denies non-mutating roles (canMutate), not just revoked grants (+1859). AgroLink review R3 (post-E3-review, Important): the scope/actor gate now runs ahead of duration parsing (it only needs deviceEui + commandType) and an invalid/missing duration now fails closed under scope instead of the legacy pass-through -- the old ordering let an actor-less, duration-less cloud VALVE_COMMAND (a real shape) return early and skip E3 entirely (+1602). AgroLink review R1 (Critical, post-E3-review): actorUuid also reads raw.actor_user_uuid/raw.actorUserUuid as defense in depth alongside Route Command's message-level copy (+411). AgroLink review R2 (Important, post-E3-review): exempts a genuine scheduler dispatch (strict msg._systemActuation === true, which cannot be smuggled in through an HTTP body or a cloud command payload) from the actor requirement, so scoped access no longer silently drops every automated irrigation decision (+1041). AgroLink review R4 (Important, post-E3-review): an actor present but denied (revoked grant or non-mutating role) now queues the same kind of terminal REJECTED_PERMANENT/scope_denied ack the actor-required branch does, instead of leaving the cloud command non-terminal for redelivery until expiry (+1682). AgroLink review X1 (post-R4-review): rethrows a scope-helper error with no .statusCode (a transient infra failure, not a deliberate scope decision) instead of queuing an irreversible REJECTED_PERMANENT for it (+692).
